title: vite.config.ts entry for apps cannot be inferred
context: New apps require minimal boilerplate, but one piece must be added manually.
decision: Apps need exactly three additions to the system: registry entry in src-tauri/src/apps/mod.rs, index.html under apps/<id>/ui/, and one line in vite.config.ts. The vite.config.ts entry cannot be inferred from other artifacts.
consequences: Missing vite.config.ts line causes app to silently fail to build—vite produces no error. This is the one piece that breaks silently. Must verify bundle includes new app.
